en: Colorized panoramic view of a coastal city with dense low-rise buildings topped by orange-tile roofs in the foreground, a busy commercial port with piers and cranes in the mid-ground, and a large sheltered bay surrounded by green hills and a central wooded peninsula or hill projecting into the water. The image has a white border like a vintage postcard. The only visible printed text is a small gray label in the bottom-left margin that reads 'Biblioteca de Galicia.'
